title: Prime Minister reflects on the immense power of devotion during Navratri
content:
Press Release:Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister reflects on the immense power of devotion during Navratri Posted On:
                22 MAR 2026 9:12AM by PIB Delhi Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today shared his reflections on the spiritual significance of Navratri, emphasizing the profound energy and strength derived from devotion to the Mother Goddess. The Prime Minister observed that there is immense power in the devotion to the Mother, noting that the worship of Devi Maa fills the hearts of devotees with positive energy. On this occasion, Shri Modi also shared a devotional hymn dedicated to the Goddess. The Prime Minister wrote on X: "माता की भक्ति में विराट शक्ति है। देवी मां की वंदना से श्रद्धालुओं का मन सकारात्मक ऊर्जा से भर जाता है।" माता की भक्ति में विराट शक्ति है। देवी मां की वंदना से श्रद्धालुओं का मन सकारात्मक ऊर्जा से भर जाता है। https://t.co/79ZDpS0dho — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) March 22, 2026 *** MJPS/PRK (Release ID: 2243477) Visitor Counter : 69 Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister reflects on the immense power of devotion during Navratri Posted On:

title: Prime Minister extends greetings on Bihar Diwas
content:
Press Release:Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister extends greetings on Bihar Diwas Posted On:
                22 MAR 2026 9:09AM by PIB Delhi Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today extended his heartiest greetings to the people of Bihar on the occasion of Bihar Diwas. The Prime Minister conveyed his best wishes to the people of the state, noting that Bihar has long bestowed grandeur and divinity upon Indian heritage. Highlighting that the state is currently engaged in scripting new chapters of progress every day, Shri Modi further affirmed his confidence that the dedication and potential of the hardworking and energetic people of Bihar will play a pivotal role in realizing the resolution of a 'Viksit Bihar' alongside a 'Viksit Bharat.' The Prime Minister wrote on X: "बिहार दिवस के अवसर पर राज्य के अपने सभी परिवारजनों को अनेकानेक शुभकामनाएं। भारतीय विरासत को भव्यता और दिव्यता प्रदान करने वाला हमारा यह प्रदेश आज प्रगति के नित-नए अध्याय गढ़ने में जुटा है। मुझे विश्वास है कि विकसित बिहार के साथ विकसित भारत के संकल्प को साकार करने में यहां के कर्मठ एवं ऊर्जावान लोगों का समर्पण और सामर्थ्य बहुत काम आएगा।" बिहार दिवस के अवसर पर राज्य के अपने सभी परिवारजनों को अनेकानेक शुभकामनाएं। भारतीय विरासत को भव्यता और दिव्यता प्रदान करने वाला हमारा यह प्रदेश आज प्रगति के नित-नए अध्याय गढ़ने में जुटा है। मुझे विश्वास है कि विकसित बिहार के साथ विकसित भारत के संकल्प को साकार करने में यहां के… — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) March 22, 2026 *** MJPS/PRK (Release ID: 2243476) Visitor Counter : 97 Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister extends greetings on Bihar Diwas Posted On:

title: Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlights the divine and benevolent grace of Goddess Kushmanda
content:
Press Release:Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlights the divine and benevolent grace of Goddess Kushmanda Posted On:
                22 MAR 2026 9:07AM by PIB Delhi Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit subhashitam today, highlighting the divine and benevolent grace of Goddess Kushmanda . title: Prime Minister reaffirms commitment to Water Conservation on World Water Day
content:
Press Release:Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister reaffirms commitment to Water Conservation on World Water Day Posted On:
                22 MAR 2026 9:05AM by PIB Delhi Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi called upon everyone to reaffirm their commitment to conserving every drop of water and using this precious resource responsibly on the occasion of World Water Day. Emphasizing the critical role of water in sustaining life and shaping the planet’s future, Shri Modi also expressed appreciation for those who engage in sustainable practices, promote awareness, and nurture a culture of conservation. The Prime Minister wrote on X: "Water sustains us and shapes our planet’s future. On World Water Day, let us reaffirm our commitment to conserve every drop of water and use it responsibly. Today is also a day to appreciate those who engage in sustainable practices, promote awareness and nurture a culture of conservation." Water sustains us and shapes our planet’s future.
